_comment: Goldenrod City. Lost tourists, the Feds holding the Radio Tower, the signs.
0: They built a new Radio Tower to replace\nthe old janky one. The old one played\fnothin' but smooth jazz. Dark times.
1: You been to the Pokéathlon Dome?\nHomies compete in sports there!\rI bet on a SLOWPOKE in the relay.\nI lost my car.
2: They opened a new Bike Shop, but I\ncan't find it ANYWHERE.\rI think it's a front. For what?\nI don't know. Bikes, prob'ly.
3: You got a Bike...\nso there IS a Bike Shop somewhere!\rI KNEW it! Nobody believed me!\nNot my wife, not my therapist!
4: That man in black dressed up like a Fed?\nThat's corny! Who dress up as a COP\ffor fun?!
5: That man in black was DEADASS a Fed?!\nI just told him about my side hustle!
6:
The Radio Tower is the big landmark
in Goldenrod City.They runnin' a promo
right now.They'll mod your Pokégear so it
work as a radio too.
7:
The Radio Tower is the big landmark
in Goldenrod City.They runnin' a promo
right now.They'll mod your Pokégear so it
work as a radio too.Oh, your Pokégear already a radio!
8: Heh heh heh...\nI got in trouble for playin' in the Dept.\fStore basement. I'm banned for life.\fI'm nine.
9: The man in that tent rate your homies'\nnames. He roasted mine for ten minutes.\fI went home and cried.
10: I'ma give my homies HARD nicknames\nif they do good in the Pokéathlon.\rIf they lose, they all gettin' named Kevin.
11: Whew! This city HUGE.\nI been lost for three days. I live here.
12: You find the Pokéathlon Dome if you go\nnorth on Route 35 past the left gate...\rBut I get lost EVERY time. I started\nleavin' bread crumbs. Birds ate 'em.
13: So THIS the Radio Tower...\nWhere Buena at? I got flowers.\r
14: What you want, lil bro?!\nScram! This a FEDERAL op! No tourists!\r
15: What you doin'?! Get to your post!\nYou on the CLOCK, rookie! Sarge watchin'!\r
16: Homies? Them ain't homies.\nThat's EVIDENCE. Seize all of 'em!\fBag it and tag it!
17: We on guard out here. Totally normal.\nJust some regular dudes in matchin'\fblack fits. Nothin' to see.
18: Take over the Radio Tower...\rWhat? I ain't SAY nothin'.\nThat was off the record! Strike it!
19: You look mad young...\nYou the new intern? Where your lanyard?\fYou can't be on a raid with no lanyard!
20: Ayo, brat! This area RESTRICTED!\nBeat it before I write you up AND\fcall your mama!
21: Ayo, ayo! I got this sector covered!\rGo report to the Radio Tower.\nAnd fill out your timesheet! In PEN!
22: Bein' homies with homies?\rHAHA! That's soft! Put that in the\nreport, Jenkins! Underline it!
23: Our dream finna come true...\nThree years of paperwork... Three years\fof budget meetings... It's all worth it.
24:
Who you? The new guy?We outta Fed uniforms, bruh.
Budget cuts.One of the boys went to grab more...He took the surveillance van.
What's takin' him so long?!The studio in the tunnel is right
around the corner. Act natural.
25: A young one like you joinin'\nThe Feds...\fYou got DENTAL now, lil bro!
26: Move!\rWe Block Hustlers ain't gon'\nlet The Feds do dirt here\fin OUR city!
27: Tee hee!\rY'all Block Hustlers is a problem.\nStay in your Block and stay outta\four way, sweetie!
28: The Block Boss Whitney ran by yellin'\n“I GOTTA GET A RADIO CARD!”\fShe was cryin'. She always cryin'.
29: Wh-what you tryna do?!\nYou don't see this pitch-black\funiform?! It's 100% POLYESTER!\rYou ain't scared of The Feds? Huh?!
30: You don't look scary enough to be\na Fed in that uniform...\fSquint and say “FREEZE!”\rClench your teeth the whole time!
31: Where you think you goin'?!\nWe in the middle of a STING!\fThis tunnel is a crime scene!
32: Where you think you goin'?\nThe Radio Tower ain't over here.\fI think. I'm new.
33: The GTS let you trade homies with the\nwhole world!\r...We read ALL them trades, btw.\nRight now we busy, though!
34: You love tradin' so much? Wait till the\nRadio Tower op done.\rThen trade all you want. We'll be\nlistenin'. Respectfully.
35: SLOW DOWN!\rI'm the ONLY one they sent here!\fUnderstaffed! No overtime pay!\fDon't make my day worse, OK?!\r
